title: Toluca to Face Monterrey in the Leagues Cup Final
seoTitle: Toluca vs Monterrey in Leagues Cup Final
subtitle: The all-Mexican clash promising silverware and a spot in the Concacaf Champions Cup
excerpt: Toluca and Monterrey meet in the 2026 Leagues Cup final in Houston. Set for 7:15 PM, the match will decide the international title and a guaranteed spot.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between Toluca and Monterrey, scheduled for 7:15 PM at Shell Energy Stadium in Houston, Texas, promises to be the marquee event of the 2026 Leagues Cup. The match, taking place this Sunday, September 6, will decide who takes the international title and secures a direct spot in the round of 16 of the 2027 Concacaf Champions Cup.

What changed in the tournament

In the opening stage, Liga MX appeared to be losing ground to MLS, with 32 victories for American clubs compared to 26 for Mexican sides. However, in the decisive phase, the final four were all from Liga MX—a scenario that had never occurred in previous editions from 2023 to 2025.

Toluca and Monterrey advance

Toluca defeated León 2-0 in the semifinal, while Monterrey secured their spot by beating América on penalties following a 2-2 draw in regulation time. Both teams will now contest the title and the opportunity to be crowned Leagues Cup champions.

Impact on MLS

With all four semifinalists hailing from Liga MX, MLS was left without representation in the top four spots, underscoring the competition's significance for the rivalry between the two North American leagues.

What is at stake

Beyond the trophy, the winner will earn direct entry into the round of 16 of the 2027 Concacaf Champions Cup, further heightening the match's importance for both clubs.

Location and date

The final will take place at Shell Energy Stadium in Houston, Texas, at 7:15 PM. The event is set to draw international attention, marking the first time two Mexican clubs contest the final of a binational tournament on American soil.

With information from OneFootball, Claro Sports.
